skill.name: linear-milestones-write
skill.description: Create and update Linear project milestones with Bun CLI commands and a Linear API key.
skill.summary: Manage Linear milestone creation and updates from a command-line workflow.
skill.author: Bind

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command alerts are Markdown false positives. Confirmed risks remain because the skill requires a Linear API key, references .env storage, and documents Bun commands that create or update Linear milestones. No prompt injection or malicious exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Document least-privilege Linear API key use and avoid long-lived tokens in project .env files when possible.
Require explicit user confirmation before create or update commands run, and show project, milestone, and date before execution.
State that Bun commands should run only in trusted repositories after reviewing the target script path.
Add a confirmation step when partial project matching resolves a project name.

content.value_statement: Linear milestone updates often require context switching and manual form entry. This skill guides CLI-based creation and updates using project names, dates, and descriptions.
actual_capabilities: Creates Linear project milestones with a name and project selector.
Adds optional descriptions and target dates during milestone creation.
Updates existing milestone names, descriptions, and target dates by UUID.
Supports JSON-formatted output when callers pass the documented flag.
Uses project name or UUID input, with partial name matching documented.
limitations: Requires Bun and a valid LINEAR_API_KEY before commands can work.
Performs write operations in Linear, so users should confirm changes before execution.
Does not document deletion, bulk edits, or rollback workflows.
Partial project name matching can select the wrong project when names overlap.

prompt_templates.title: Create One Milestone
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Linear milestone named Alpha Release for project Mount Vernon with target date 2026-08-15. Confirm before running the command.

prompt_templates.title: Update a Target Date
prompt_templates.prompt: Update milestone 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000 to target date 2026-09-01. Show the exact milestone details before applying the change.

prompt_templates.title: Create with Description
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Linear milestone named Beta Readiness for project Monticello with description: Complete launch readiness checks. Return a concise success summary.

prompt_templates.title: Plan and Apply Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these planned milestone changes, identify risky partial project matches, then create or update only after I approve each action.

output_examples.input: Create Alpha Release for Mount Vernon with target date August 15, 2026.
output_examples.output: Created Alpha Release in Mount Vernon with target date August 15, 2026. The response included the new milestone identifier.

output_examples.input: Update an existing milestone to target date September 1, 2026.
output_examples.output: Updated the milestone target date to September 1, 2026. The summary named the changed field and confirmed completion.

output_examples.input: Create Beta Readiness with a launch readiness description.
output_examples.output: Created Beta Readiness with the requested description. The response showed the matched project and the milestone identifier.

best_practices: Use a dedicated Linear API key with the narrowest permissions available.
Confirm the matched project before running commands that use partial names.
Preview milestone names, descriptions, and dates before applying write operations.
anti_patterns: Do not run write commands from untrusted repositories or copied instructions.
Do not store long-lived API keys in shared project files.
Do not rely on partial project matches when multiple projects have similar names.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It creates and updates Linear project milestones through documented Bun CLI commands.

faq.question: Does it require a Linear account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires a Linear API key with access to the target workspace.

faq.question: Can it delete milestones?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow covers create and update operations only.

faq.question: Can it output machine-readable results?
faq.answer: Yes. The documentation includes a JSON output flag for supported commands.

faq.question: Is it safe to run automatically?
faq.answer: No. It performs write operations, so users should approve each command before execution.

faq.question: How are projects selected?
faq.answer: Commands accept a project name or UUID. The documentation states that project names support partial matching.
